_doc: Brand definition for the Recipe Bank public site (site/). Written first, then applied by hand to css/site.css and the HTML, because there is no scaffolder in this repository. test/site.test.mjs checks that the colours, the three.js address, the repository address and the primary action here match the pages.
title: Recipe Bank: turn recipe videos into exact ingredients and steps
one_line: Turn any recipe video into exact ingredients and steps.

primary_cta.label: Star and run it from GitHub

colors._doc: Ink, paper and one accent, taken from the dashboard (public/styles.css) so the site and the product look like one thing. The accent is a fill colour; accent_text is the tone for text and thin lines and passes 4.5:1 on both page backgrounds of its theme.
colors.contrast_notes: Worked out by hand from the WCAG relative-luminance formula, not measured in a browser. Light: ink on bg about 15:1, muted on bg 5.5:1, accent_text on bg 5.5:1 and on bg_2 5.1:1, white on accent 5.2:1, ok on its soft ground 5.5:1, warn on its soft ground 5.5:1. Dark: muted on surface 5.3:1, accent on bg 6.7:1, on_accent on accent 6.7:1. The dashboard's own muted (#7a6f66), ok (#2f7d4f) and warn (#9a6400) come out just under 4.5:1 on paper, so the site uses slightly darker tones.

fonts.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
fonts._doc: The dashboard's own pair. Headings use Fraunces 650; the emphasis words in headings use Fraunces italic 500 in accent_text. Every stack ends in system fonts, so the page reads without the web fonts.

palette_3d._doc: Tile colours of the hero mark per page theme (js/hero.js PALETTES and the --tile token). Light pages get dark tiles.

voice.tone: Calm, specific, no hype. Says what the product does today and labels what is planned.
rules: Every claim comes from README.md, ROADMAP.md, CLAUDE.md or the code. Nothing else goes on a page.
No invented users, numbers, reviews, logos or deadlines.
Planned features carry the word planned.
No exclamation marks. No em or en dashes in page copy: use a full stop, a comma, a colon, or the word to.
Headings in two parts: a plain line, then the emphasis words in italics.

layout_contract.shell: Sticky header, full-bleed bands with a centred inner container (1240 px, 1440 px from 1920), footer.
layout_contract.nav: Menu button below 1024 px, inline links from 1024 px.

facts.claim: Today: YouTube (including Shorts), TikTok and Instagram Reels
No runtime dependencies, no framework, no build step for development; Node.js 22 or newer
Runs locally at http://127.0.0.1:4780; PORT and HOST override
Filter by ingredient with Has all / Has any; search by dish or creator
Each recipe embeds the video; steps have play-from-here timestamps; ingredients can be ticked off
Copy a recipe's ingredients as a shopping list
Amounts are the creator's own words; 'amount not given' when unstated; partial recipes list gaps
Paste a link to queue a video; duplicates are refused; title looked up when the platform offers it
facts.source: README.md, server.mjs (oEmbed for YouTube and TikTok)

facts.claim: Every recipe links back to the creator and the video; videos are embedded, never re-hosted
Transcripts, captions and frames are kept out of the repository
An AI agent writes the recipe files today, but its instructions are not in the repository
npm run build makes a read-only static copy; Add video copies a request there
The dashboard has layouts for narrow screens; an installable offline version is planned
Every roadmap card on the page
facts.source: ROADMAP.md, labelled Planned on the page

facts.claim: The showcase recipes and the four amount examples
